name: Jump pad
brief: MK-181 Jump pad. Round 2, matched to the pick: a low round puck 1.8 m across, a thick panelled outer ring with warm orange windows round its side, a green "ready" ring inset on the top and a dark grated launch plate in the middle. Step on it and the plate squashes, the ring chases inward, and you sail in a slow low-gravity arc.

rounds.t: First build from the pack style and the Faceted Hero rules, no Midjourney pick yet.
Rebuilt against the Midjourney pick: chunky off-white modules held by dark bumper frames (bkit.module), warm orange windows (bkit.window), darker ground. Round 1 kept in round1/.
